entities.summary:
Kimberley Anne Woltemas is a Thai-German 
actress and model. She made her breakthrough in acting career after she played the role of Nam in the series 4 Huajai Haeng Koon Kao for the first part of the series, Thara Himalaya, where she was paired up with Atichart Chumnanon.
